posts.title: SETI: Impressions and Link Roundup
posts.description: I have a love/hate relationship with SETI, which I’ve played 12 times this year and which is—at the time of this writing—ranked #14 on BoardGameGeek out of over 31,000 ranked games.

posts.title: Farscape’s Top 20 Episodes in Chronological Order (with Bonus Episodes for Continuity)
posts.description: I ended up building a list of the Top 20 Farscape episodes instead of the Top 10 or Top 15 because doing so includes each part of the highest-rated “two parters” and “three parters.”

posts.title: Player Principles
posts.description: While the first edition of Apocalypse World introduced GM Principles, codifying corresponding Player Principles seems to have emerged independently around 2018 from both the OSR and the community hacking Dungeon World.
